I couldn't find a night-dispatch contact for Driftmoor Marine Freight. The notes I can see mention that Driftmoor requested a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift in November 2025, but they don't name the dispatcher or anyone else there.

There's a night dispatcher named Hector in the notes, but he's at Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Beaumont barge slip), a different account, so I wouldn't send the Driftmoor note to him. Kwame is the best person to ask for the Driftmoor contact, since he runs that account.
